verdict.rationale: Clerky is a SaaS legal-paperwork platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair axis, but the evidence shows no in-product assistant. The only AI-related evidence is a remote MCP server that lets external assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT call read-only Clerky tools. That is a different capability (serving tools to outside agents) and does not count as a built-in assistant you can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
